items.stem: At a J-turn intersection on a four-lane highway, how do you head left instead of crossing fast traffic?

options.text: Turn right with traffic, merge to the far left lane, then turn left
options.rationale: at a J-turn, instead of crossing fast traffic you turn right with traffic, merge to the far left lane, and then turn left in the direction you want.

options.text: Cross all lanes directly
options.rationale: Wrong: a J-turn avoids crossing fast traffic.

options.text: Make a U-turn from the right lane
options.rationale: Wrong: you merge left first, then turn left.

options.text: Stop in the median and wait
options.rationale: Wrong: you turn right, merge, then turn left.

items.correct_rationale: Option A is correct: at a J-turn, instead of crossing fast traffic you turn right with traffic, merge to the far left lane, and then turn left in the direction you want.
